'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: PROBABLY GONNA GET SHIELD BUSTED TODAY.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
